cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Choose the Precedent
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which rule, custom, or prior decision will govern what happens now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Who gets the head seat: Grandma or the birthday child? We have traditions for both.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Fine. Which tradition decides who gets served first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Serve them together. Except there's only one birthday pudding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choose before I bring it in: elders first or birthdays first? I can divide the pudding once somebody's had the wish.

mechanism: A supervises birthday service by requiring a choice between elder and birthday precedence when physical duplication cannot resolve a single first turn.
confusable: Ordinary seating negotiation differs from D178's choice of governing custom rather than simple arrangement.
comparison: A family first-serving ritual differs from event opening rules.
seedUse: Keep two chairs and one pudding; focus on an explicit indivisible first cut rather than an unprepared wish rule.
